# IQAir AirVisual

IQAir AirVisual provides global air quality data through its API, offering real-time and historical information on air pollution levels.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/iqair-airvisual/.

## Actions

- **Get Air Quality Forecast Data** (read-only): Retrieve air quality forecast data for a specified city, state, and country.
- **Get Cities** (read-only): List supported cities in a specified state and country.
- **Get City Air Quality** (read-only): Retrieve air quality data for a specific city.
- **Get Historical AQI Data** (read-only): Retrieve historical air quality data for a city.
- **Get Nearest City Air Quality** (read-only): Retrieve air quality data for the nearest city based on latitude/longitude or IP.
- **Get Nearest Station Air Quality** (read-only): Get nearest station air quality.
- **Get States** (read-only): List supported states in a specified country.
- **Get Station by ID** (read-only): Fetch air quality and weather data for a specific monitoring station by ID.
- **Get supported countries** (read-only): List all supported countries.
- **Get World AQI Rankings** (read-only): Retrieve a ranking of cities worldwide based on current AQI.
